texts.source_text: Mothers' Decisions can Change the World - Part 1
texts.content_exam: One day Thomas Edison came home and gave his mother a letter from his teacher. As she read the letter, his mother's eyes were tearful. Thomas Edison's teacher wrote that Edison was mentally ill and wouldn't be allowed in school anymore. When Edison asked his mother what this letter was about, she pretended to read it aloud, saying your son couldn't go to school because he was a genius and the school was too small for him. 'Please teach him yourself.' Edison's mother hid the letter and decided to educate young Thomas at home. Edison was homeschooled by his mother's decision; he wasn't able to memorize lessons and needed hands-on experience to understand and learn things. Edison's mother wasn't frustrated; she wanted Edison to be a scientist.

questions.question: What did Thomas Edison give his mother?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: A letter from his teacher

questions.question: What did the teacher write about Edison?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: He was mentally ill

questions.question: What did Edison's mother tell him about the letter?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: He was a genius

questions.question: What did Edison's mother decide to do?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: Educate him at home (decided to educate young Thomas at home).

questions.question: Why wasn't Edison able to memorize lessons?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: He needed hands-on experience (he wasn't able to memorize lessons and needed hands-on experience).

texts.source_text: Mothers' Decisions can Change the World - Part 2
texts.content_exam: He grew up and set up a laboratory at home and began his own experiments. He also set up his own telegraph station and sent out messages by using a train whistle. At the age of 30, Edison invented the phonograph. His work in a number of fields created the basis for many technologies that we enjoy today. However, like anyone else, he suffered through failure numerous times, but where others quit, he persisted. After his mother's death, one day Edison found the hidden school letter, cried for hours and then he wrote in his diary, Thomas Alva Edison was a mentally ill child that, by a hero mother, became a genius. Edison said: 'My mother was a great woman, she believed in me and made me one of the greatest inventors'.

questions.question: Edison invented the phonograph at the age of 30.
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: True

questions.question: Edison never faced failure in his life.
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: False (He suffered through failure numerous times).

questions.question: Edison's mother believed in him and made him a great inventor.
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: True

questions.question: How did Edison's mother help him become successful?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: She believed in him and homeschooled him.

questions.question: What did Edison write in his diary after finding the letter?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: He wrote that he was a mentally ill child who, by a hero mother, became a genius.

texts.source_text: All are Involved Without Exception - Part 1
texts.content_exam: From an early age, Isabella Springmuhl Tejada decided to follow the footsteps of her grandmother who was a designer. As a child, Isabella would create clothes for her dolls, but playing eventually turned into work when she enrolled in a fashion course. Her designs aimed specifically at people with Down Syndrome. Springmuhl had her first big showcase in 2015, where she sold her complete collection. The success of her show garnered international attention, and in 2016 her designs were shown at London Fashion Week, which was followed by another exhibit in Rome. Sujeet Desai is from Buffalo, New York. He graduated from high school. Two years later, he decided to study music and graduated from Berkshire Hills Music Academy. Now he is a famous musician. All in all, Desai can play seven instruments.

questions.question: Isabella Springmuhl Tejada decided to follow the footsteps of her ______.
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: grandmother

questions.question: Isabella's designs aimed specifically at people with ______.
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: Down Syndrome

questions.question: What did Isabella create as a child?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: Clothes for her dolls (Isabella would create clothes for her dolls).

questions.question: When did Springmuhl have her first big showcase?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: In 2015 (had her first big showcase in 2015).

questions.question: Where were Isabella's designs shown in 2016?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: London Fashion Week (in 2016 her designs were shown at London Fashion Week).

texts.source_text: All are Involved Without Exception - Part 2
texts.content_exam: Sujeet Desai decided to study music and graduated from Berkshire Hills Music Academy. His greatest accomplishment so far was his 2015 performance at Carnegie Hall, for which he received a standing ovation. Pablo Pineda is an actor and educator most well-known for being the first European with Down Syndrome who made his decision to obtain a university degree. In 2009, he won the Silver Shell Award at the International Film Festival for his role in Yo Tambien, a film about a university graduate with Down Syndrome. Although he still acts, Pineda is currently working on implementing an international strategy to increase employment opportunities for people with disabilities. People are able to challenge difficult circumstances and be successful. They can make the right decision if they are well-trained and if they intend to do so.

questions.question: Pablo Pineda won the Silver Shell Award in 2009.
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: True

questions.question: Pineda is currently working on implementing a national strategy.
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: False (international strategy).

questions.question: People cannot make the right decision if they are not well-trained.
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: False (They can make the right decision if they are well-trained).

questions.question: What is Pablo Pineda working on currently?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: implementing an international strategy to increase employment opportunities for people with disabilities

questions.question: What do the examples of successful people with Down Syndrome prove?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: Having a disability does not prevent anyone from achieving great things and making a difference.
